title: Asking for help
examples: If I fall down, who should I tell?
What words can I use when I need help?
Is it okay to ask a grown-up for help?

explain.say: Sometimes you feel big feelings. You might feel sad or lost.
If you feel big feelings, you should ask a grown-up. A teacher or parent can help you.
If you need help with a toy, you can say, 'May I please have a turn?' This is a good way to ask.

draw.text: Say: 'May I please have a turn?'

explain.say: If you are hurt, you must say, 'I need help.' This tells the grown-up right away.

faq.q: Who is it okay to ask for help?
faq.a: You can ask a teacher or a parent. These are people who help keep you safe.

faq.q: What if I don't know what to say?
faq.a: You can point and say, 'I need help.' Using your words is very important.
asks: What if I forget my words?

faq.q: Do I have to use my words?
faq.a: Yes, using your words helps people know how to help you best. It keeps you safe.

faq.q: Can I ask two people for help?
faq.a: It is okay to tell a grown-up if you need help. They will listen to you.
asks: Is it too much to ask?

faq.q: What if the grown-up is busy?
faq.a: You can wait a little bit and try again. You can gently remind them that you need help.

facts: Telling a grown-up when you are hurt is important.
Saying 'please' and 'thank you' helps when you ask for things.
Trusted adults are people who keep you safe.
Using your words helps people understand your feelings.

quiz.say: If your tower falls down, who should you tell?
quiz.why: A teacher or parent is a trusted grown-up who can help you.

wrong.0: Sometimes we need someone else to help us feel better.
wrong.2: Friends are fun, but a grown-up knows how to fix big things.
wrong.3: The toy box cannot talk back to you.

quiz.say: If you want a turn with the red crayon, what should you say?

options.show: May I please have a turn?
options.say: May I please have a turn?

quiz.why: Using 'May I please' is a polite way to ask for something.

wrong.1: This sounds too loud and might make friends sad.
wrong.2: This word can make other people feel left out.
wrong.3: It is better to use softer, polite words.

quiz.say: When you feel scared, what is the best thing to do?
quiz.why: A trusted grown-up can give you a big hug and help you feel safe.

wrong.0: Running away alone can make you feel more scared.
wrong.1: Crying is okay, but you should also tell someone grown-up.
wrong.2: Hiding might make it hard for grown-ups to find you.
